verses.original: מִזְמ֡וֹר שִׁיר־ חֲנֻכַּ֖ת הַבַּ֣יִת לְדָוִֽד׃ אֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה כִּ֣י דִלִּיתָ֑נִי וְלֹא־ שִׂמַּ֖חְתָּ אֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr šîr- ḥă·nuk·kaṯ hab·ba·yiṯ lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ă·rō·w·mim·ḵā Yah·weh kî ḏil·lî·ṯā·nî wə·lō- śim·maḥ·tā ’ō·yə·ḇay lî
verses.literal: A Psalm A song for the dedication of the temple Of David I will exalt You O LORD for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me
verses.literalPt: EXALTAR-TE-EI, ó SENHOR, porque tu me exaltaste; e não fizeste com que meus inimigos se alegrassem sobre mim.

verses.literal: O LORD my God I cried to You for help and You healed me
verses.literalPt: SENHOR meu Deus, clamei a ti, e tu me saraste.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה הֶֽעֱלִ֣יתָ מִן־ שְׁא֣וֹל נַפְשִׁ֑י חִ֝יִּיתַ֗נִי מִיּוֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh he·‘ĕ·lî·ṯā min- šə·’ō·wl nap̄·šî ḥî·yî·ṯa·nî mī·yō·rə·ḏē ḇō·wr
verses.literal: O LORD You pulled me up from Sheol You spared me from descending into the Pit
verses.literalPt: SENHOR, fizeste subir a minha alma da sepultura; conservaste-me a vida para que não descesse ao abismo.

verses.original: זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חֲסִידָ֑יו וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: zam·mə·rū Yah·weh ḥă·sî·ḏāw wə·hō·w·ḏū lə·zê·ḵer qā·ḏə·šōw
verses.literal: Sing to the LORD O you His saints and praise His holy name
verses.literalPt: Cantai ao SENHOR, vós que sois seus santos, e celebrai a memória da sua santidade.

verses.original: כִּ֤י רֶ֨גַע׀ בְּאַפּוֹ֮ חַיִּ֪ים בִּרְצ֫וֹנ֥וֹ בָּ֭עֶרֶב יָלִ֥ין בֶּ֗כִי וְלַבֹּ֥קֶר רִנָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî re·ḡa‘ bə·’ap·pōw ḥay·yîm bir·ṣō·w·nōw bā·‘e·reḇ yā·lîn be·ḵî wə·lab·bō·qer rin·nāh
verses.literal: For His anger is fleeting but His favor lasts a lifetime Weeping may stay the night but joy comes in the morning
verses.literalPt: Porque a sua ira dura só um momento; no seu favor está a vida. O choro pode durar uma noite, mas a alegria vem pela manhã.

verses.original: וַ֭אֲנִי אָמַ֣רְתִּי בְשַׁלְוִ֑י בַּל־ אֶמּ֥וֹט לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.literal: In prosperity I said I will never . . . be shaken
verses.literalPt: Eu dizia na minha prosperidade: Não vacilarei jamais.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה בִּרְצוֹנְךָ֮ הֶעֱמַ֪דְתָּה לְֽהַרְרִ֫י עֹ֥ז הִסְתַּ֥רְתָּ פָנֶ֗יךָ הָיִ֥יתִי נִבְהָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh bir·ṣō·wn·ḵā he·‘ĕ·maḏ·tāh lə·har·rî ‘ōz his·tar·tā p̄ā·ne·ḵā hā·yî·ṯî niḇ·hāl
verses.literal: O LORD You favored me You made my mountain stand strong When You hid Your face I was dismayed
verses.literalPt: Tu, SENHOR, pelo teu favor fizeste forte a minha montanha; tu encobriste o teu rosto, e fiquei perturbado.

verses.original: אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א וְאֶל־ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃
verses.literal: To You O LORD I called and I begged my Lord for mercy
verses.literalPt: A ti, SENHOR, clamei, e ao SENHOR supliquei.

verses.original: מַה־ בֶּ֥צַע בְּדָמִי֮ בְּרִדְתִּ֪י אֶ֫ל־ שָׁ֥חַת הֲיוֹדְךָ֥ עָפָ֑ר הֲיַגִּ֥יד אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mah- be·ṣa‘ bə·ḏā·mî bə·riḏ·tî ’el- šā·ḥaṯ hă·yō·wḏ·ḵā ‘ā·p̄ār hă·yag·gîḏ ’ă·mit·te·ḵā
verses.literal: What gain is there in my bloodshed in my descent to the Pit Will the dust praise You Will it proclaim Your faithfulness
verses.literalPt: Que proveito há no meu sangue, quando desço à cova? Porventura te louvará o pó? Anunciará ele a tua verdade?

verses.original: שְׁמַע־ יְהוָ֥ה וְחָנֵּ֑נִי יְ֝הוָה הֱ‍ֽיֵה־ עֹזֵ֥ר לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘- Yah·weh wə·ḥān·nê·nî haš·šēm hĕyêh- ‘ō·zêr lî
verses.literal: Hear me O LORD and have mercy O LORD be my helper
verses.literalPt: Ouve, SENHOR, e tem piedade de mim, SENHOR; sê o meu auxílio.

verses.original: הָפַ֣כְתָּ מִסְפְּדִי֮ לְמָח֪וֹל לִ֥י פִּתַּ֥חְתָּ שַׂקִּ֑י וַֽתְּאַזְּרֵ֥נִי שִׂמְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·p̄aḵ·tā mis·pə·ḏî lə·mā·ḥō·wl lî pit·taḥ·tā śaq·qî wat·tə·’az·zə·rê·nî śim·ḥāh
verses.literal: You turned my mourning into dancing You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy
verses.literalPt: Tornaste o meu pranto em folguedo; desataste o meu pano de saco, e me cingiste de alegria,

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן׀ יְזַמֶּרְךָ֣ כָ֭בוֹד וְלֹ֣א יִדֹּ֑ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י לְעוֹלָ֥ם אוֹדֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an yə·zam·mer·ḵā ḵā·ḇō·wḏ wə·lō yid·dōm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hay lə·‘ō·w·lām ’ō·w·ḏe·kā
verses.literal: that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent O LORD my God I will give thanks forever
verses.literalPt: Para que a minha glória a ti cante louvores, e não se cale. SENHOR, meu Deus, eu te louvarei para sempre.
